# HeraWallet - Intelligent AI Financial Assistant

> HeraWallet is a modern, privacy-focused personal finance management platform powered by artificial intelligence. Available in Spanish and English.

## Overview
- Website: https://herawallet.app
- Spanish Landing: https://herawallet.app/es/
- English Landing: https://herawallet.app/en/

## Core Capabilities
- Voice & Photo Expense Logging: Natural language voice input and OCR receipt scanning.
- Smart Budgeting & Predictions: Predictive monthly spending score and automated insights.
- Privacy-First Design: No direct bank access required, 100% encrypted & private data.
- Multi-Platform Support: Web Progressive Web App (PWA), Android App, Responsive Web.

- Sitemap: https://herawallet.app/sitemap.xml
- Web App Manifest: https://herawallet.app/manifest.webmanifest
